about.title: From a Houston roofing contractor to full industrial construction
text: We were founded in Houston in 1956 and built our reputation in roofing and sheet metal services.
Since 2002 we have expanded into complete construction services, and our service line has grown to meet our clients' work.
We service more than 90 industrial facilities along the upper gulf coast and have Master Agreements with most of them, with our own crews performing most of the construction.
